newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas firmer as volume of trade recovers.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas firmer as volume of trade recovers.

text.p: Volumes on the IPE natural gas futures contract picked up slightly on Thursday, with 125 lots traded in five separate deals.
Front month August saw two deals at 9.275 pence and one at 9.30 pence a therm. The contract settled at 9.30 pence, an increase of 0.085 pence from Wednesday's level.
October and January each traded 25 lots at 10.75 pence and 17.40 pence respectively. They were both up, by 0.045 pence and 0.225 pence, from the previous settlement level.
The total of 125 lots compares with 50 lots on Wednesday and 70 lots on Tuesday.
